meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 成为 Google Cirq 框架专家，能设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持 Google、IonQ 等硬件后端，并可进行噪声建模、参数扫描与实验。
howto.when: 当用户需要构建或模拟 NISQ 电路、运行量子硬件任务、建模噪声或设计量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 写一个两量子比特的 Bell 态电路，并模拟 1000 次。
创建一个参数化电路，对 theta 做 0 到 2π 的扫描。
say.note: 生成参数化电路并执行扫描。

say.text: 帮我用 Google 硬件运行这个电路，使用 Weber 处理器。
say.note: 需要配置 Google Cloud 项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Cirq expert: can design, simulate, and run quantum circuits, supporting Google Quantum AI, IonQ, Azure Quantum, and other backends, plus noise modeling, parameter sweeps, and experiments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build or simulate NISQ circuits, run jobs on Google or partner hardware, model noise, or design characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Write a Bell state circuit for two qubits and simulate 1000 shots.
Create a parameterized circuit with a theta sweep from 0 to 2π.
Run this circuit on Google hardware using the Weber processor.
